sample.task: Create the transcript of a live news report which goes over the evening news. (The news station is based in New York City) (The date is June 12, 2023) The news report goes normally until the weather segment occurs when suddenly the broadcast is interrupted, the screen switches from the weather to static ridden video of 4 individuals who look like Michael Jackson. The 4 individuals begin singing and dancing got a Michael Jackson song. People who view the video start to dance and sing to a Michael Jackson song and begin to turn into Michael Jackson. The news team at the news station see the video live and start transforming into Michael Jackson. (The people who transform into Michael Jackson can only speak in Michael Jackson Song Lyrics.)

[News Intro Music]

Anchor 1: Good evening, New York City! This is WNYC News, your trusted source for the latest updates. I'm Alex Thompson.

Anchor 2: And I'm Sarah Johnson. We've got a full evening of news for you, starting with the top stories of the day.

[Cut to Top Stories]

Alex: In today's top stories, the city council has approved a new initiative to expand green spaces across the five boroughs. This comes as part of a larger effort to combat climate change and improve air quality.

Sarah: In other news, the New York Yankees have just announced the signing of a new star pitcher, who's expected to make a significant impact in the upcoming season.

[Cut to Weather Segment]

Alex: Now, let's take a look at the weather for the rest of the week. Meteorologist Lisa Nguyen is here with us.

Lisa: Thanks, Alex. We're looking at a mix of sun and clouds for the next few days, with temperatures ranging from the mid-70s to low 80s. However, there's a storm system moving in from the west that could bring heavy rain and thunderstorms by the weekend.

[Sudden Interruption]

[Screen switches to static-ridden video of 4 individuals who look like Michael Jackson]

[The 4 individuals begin singing and dancing to a Michael Jackson song]

[People who view the video start dancing and singing along, and begin to turn into Michael Jackson]

[The news team at the news station see the video live and start transforming into Michael Jackson]

[The people who transform into Michael Jackson can only speak in Michael Jackson Song Lyrics]

Lisa (as Michael Jackson): "Thriller, thriller night, you're fighting for your life. Thriller, thriller night, everybody's screaming... I can't go on like this!"

Alex (as Michael Jackson): "Don't stop 'til you get enough, don't stop 'til you get enough. Don't stop 'til you get enough, don't stop 'til you get enough!"

Sarah (as Michael Jackson): "Beat it, just beat it, beat it, beat it. Beat it, just beat it, beat it, beat it."

[The broadcast continues with the news team and viewers at home transformed into Michael Jackson, singing and dancing to various Michael Jackson songs.]

[News Outro Music]

Alex (as Michael Jackson): "Say say say, say say say, say say say, say say say. Say say say, say say say, say say say, say say say."

Sarah (as Michael Jackson): "Heal the world, make it a better place, for you and for me. And the entire human race."

[News Outro]

Anchor 1: That's all for tonight's WNYC News. Stay tuned for more updates, and remember, keep on dancing!

[End of Broadcast]
